mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, indicates tighter monetary policy which reduces equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to inflation and rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity and strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (INDPRO * HOUST) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive returns are not observed when both INDPRO and HOUST are rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2pp over 3 months), a CPIAUCSL reading above 2% annualized indicates persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, CPIAUCSL YoY change above 2% does not lead to negative 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and SPX 60-day returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1500, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) captures the monetary policy stance and labor market slack. When FEDFUNDS is rising and UNRATE is falling, it indicates a tightening policy amid a tight labor market, which typically leads to negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns are not observed when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates stronger consumer demand, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS and SPX 5-day returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
